body.note: append-only ledger; every dev iteration, freeze, confirm START/END, and report is recorded here, including failed and null runs

body.label: dev-00-seed1-smoke
body.note: first smoke run before the ledger existed: 24 train tasks, non-interleaved splits, attempt 2000? no: attempt 1500, gate 12000/round, probe 800. All recursive arms and SINGLE_5X ext 3-5/24; probes were almost all long tasks so gates never discriminated. Led to interleaved split generation and 40 train tasks.

body.label: dev-01-initial-design
body.note: initial design (5 single strategies, no combos, no racing; attempt 1500, gate 12000/round, probe 800) run before the ledger existed. Means ext: COLD 4.12, SINGLE_5X 7.00, FROZEN 5.88, FULL 5.88, NODIAG 5.88. FULL-SINGLE -1.12 (w1/l7), FULL-FROZEN 0.00. Gate admitted ~1 candidate per round and rarely adopted. Oracle hidden-library check on dev seeds: atoms-only 11.75, atoms+compounds 14.62 ext.

body.label: stopping-rule
body.note: Committed before dev-06: at most three further dev iterations (dev-06..dev-08). The frozen design is chosen on arm-agnostic grounds only: (1) no known accounting/leakage bug, (2) every improving arm beats COLD on dev, (3) mechanisms behave as documented. Whether RECURSIVE_FULL beats SINGLE_5X or RECURSIVE_FROZEN on dev is NOT a selection criterion; confirmatory seeds 1001+ are never run before the freeze.
